classification: Requirements inventory; no final-approved visual conformity or behavioural completion is asserted by enumeration.
common_controls: Protected by Default disclosure with actual scope
Notification entry and actual unread state

common_tests.positive: Use the control with keyboard and pointer on real routes, verify persisted or backend outcome and compare the complete page against its exact approved reference.
common_tests.negative: Authorization, CSRF, wrong owner, stale state, malformed/oversized input, interrupted operation, unavailable backend and truthful unknown outcomes as applicable.
common_tests.visual: All controls require final-reference comparison at native dimensions and 360/768/1440, light/dark/system, 200% reflow and forced colours; an old passing test is not conformity.
common_tests.security: Existing boundaries remain mandatory; first-party enhancements require a bounded work order and reviewed CSP/isolation tests before implementation.
